items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: But he got a telegram from Bruce Lundwall at Blue Note, no, at Capitol Records.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was laying there with these things tying him down and everything, and he says, “Get these things off of me.” I was so glad for his temper to come back you know. And so he didn’t want to get the bypass. He was too scared of it. And it was at that time very new. So there was something called chelation therapy that one of his friends had told him about, and so he decided he’d do that. And I’m glad he did, because he would have never gotten to Japan otherwise I don’t think. He took the chelation therapy for…
